title: Projection composition on a compatible choice of compactifications
statement: For a finite operation stage S [def-sf-operation-stages], separated locally finite type quasi-compact f:X→Y and g:Y→Z and a prescribed compactification cg of g, there exist compactifications cf of f and cfg of fg such that the prescribed finite projection [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies the composition square for all bounded constructible first inputs K and finite-Tor constructible second inputs L. The maps in the square are exactly S.finite.composition and torPullComposition. The choices cf,cfg can be taken from the compatible Cartesian triangle; the statement does not assert the square for arbitrary first and composite compactifications and asserts no pentagon.

source.place: Composition and coherence sentence, realized using the specified finite operation normalizations.

proof.text: Construct the compatible Cartesian proper/open triangle over the prescribed cg using exists_compatible_compactification_triangle. Lift its ambient schemes and maps to SixFunctorSpace. Its factor compactifications give cf,cfg and recover cg exactly.

Apply compositionProjectionMate at the positive coefficient exponent. Transfer its TriangleLaws along the proved fixedScalarTensorData_eq so the raw and finite-coordinate tensors have the same named presentation. Alpha is unchanged. Its raw alpha is invertible and its leftMap equals rightMap. Realize that equation with the coefficient-equivalence functor.

Use iteration_realization for the two successive projection components and binary_composition_realization for the two compositor endpoints. Identify the single total projection with the raw factor projection by unfolding projectionMapOfCompactification_app_app and its equality transport. Cancel the explicit endpoint isomorphisms and reflect through the faithful constructible inclusion.

theorem exists_component_binary_square
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn) :
    ∀ {X Y Z : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    [IsSeparated g.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType g.hom.left] [QuasiCompact g.hom.left]
    (cg : Compactification g.hom.left),
    ∃ (cf : Compactification f.hom.left) (cfg : Compactification (f ≫ g).hom.left),
    ∀ (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Z.obj.left),
      ((partialTensor S Z).map ((S.finite.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app K)).app L ≫
          component S g cg ((S.finite.support f cf).obj K) L ≫
          (S.finite.support g cg).map
            (component S f cf K ((torPull S g).obj L)) =
        component S (f ≫ g) cfg K L ≫
          (S.finite.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app
            (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S (f ≫ g)).obj L)) ≫
          (S.finite.support g cg).map ((S.finite.support f cf).map
            (((partialTensor S X).obj K).map (torPullComposition S f g L).hom))
